stories.title: Arkansas held No. 17 South Carolina to 6 points, a season low
stories.dek: The 4-6 Razorbacks beat the ranked Gamecocks 34-6, holding them 25.8 points below their season average.
stories.hero_stat: 6 points allowed — South Carolina's fewest this season

stories.title: Utah survived Arizona 40-39 after its defense gave up a season-high 39
stories.dek: Arizona scored 39 points, 22.7 more than Utah had allowed on average, and the Utes still won on a 70-yard touchdown with 2:25 left.
stories.hook: No. 2 Utah survives, stays unbeaten on late 70-yard TD in thriller vs. Arizona
stories.hero_stat: 39 points allowed — Utah's most this season

stories.title: Washington State's 73 points are its most since at least 2021
stories.dek: The 2-8 Cougars beat Colorado State 73-7, a 66-point margin that is also their largest since at least 2021.
stories.hero_stat: 73 points — Washington State's most since at least 2021

stories.title: Colorado's first AP top-15 win in 19 years: 42-32 over No. 14 Houston
stories.dek: The Buffaloes lost to No. 12 Texas Tech and No. 11 Utah this season before beating No. 14 Houston 42-32.
stories.hook: Colorado upsets No. 14 Houston for 1st AP top-15 win since 2007
stories.hero_stat: 19 years since Colorado's last AP top-15 win

stories.title: UCLA is 10-0 for the first time since 1998, its 3rd 10-0 start
stories.dek: The Bruins held Illinois scoreless in the first half and to 240 yards, forcing 3 interceptions in a 22-14 win.

stories.title: Memphis has the FBS's only 2 50-point road games through Week 11
stories.dek: Marcus Stokes has accounted for 5 touchdowns in 3 straight games, and Jaylin Carter just passed 1,000 rushing yards.
stories.hook: Stokes has 5 total TDs, Memphis blows 21-point lead before beating South Florida 52-41
stories.hero_stat: 2 road games of 50-plus points, the only team in the FBS

stories.title: Georgia beat No. 10 Ole Miss 42-7, the biggest top-10 blowout this season
stories.dek: The 35-point margin is 27 points wider than any other game between top-10 teams this season.

stories.title: Notre Dame held No. 1 Miami to 24 points, its season low
stories.dek: Miami entered Saturday averaging 47.6 points a game, the most in FBS; its previous low was 33.
stories.hero_stat: 24 points allowed to the No. 1 scoring offense

stories.title: Ranked teams lost 5 games to unranked opponents for a 2nd straight week
stories.dek: All 5 Week 9 losses came on the road, where ranked teams are 6-10 over the last 2 weeks.

stories.title: Ranked teams lost 5 times to unranked opponents in Week 8, the most this season
stories.dek: All 5 losses came on the road, where ranked teams went 3-5; at home they went 7-0.
stories.hero_stat: 5 of 15 ranked teams lost to unranked opponents
